overview_description.description: IndieGoGo is a crowdfunding platform that democratizes the way people raise funds for any project such as creative, entrepreneurial, or cause-related. The platform enables individuals and startups to generate pre-sales and collect feedback from early adopters before they manufacture their products. Since its inception in 2008, Indiegogo has been offering related advice to individuals and startups that seek it and advising corporations on how to staff a team to create and manage a campaign effectively.

product.description: An online crowdfunding platform where entrepreneurs and creators raise funds for new products, projects, and initiatives from backers worldwide.

product.name: Campaign Launch and Fundraising Tools
product.description: Tools that help project creators create crowdfunding campaigns, present their ideas, collect contributions, communicate with supporters, and manage campaign activity.

product.name: Project Discovery and Backer Support
product.description: A marketplace-style discovery experience that helps backers find crowdfunding campaigns and support projects in technology, design, and other categories.

product.name: Indiegogo InDemand
product.description: A post-campaign fundraising service that allows eligible creators to continue collecting support and promoting a project after its initial crowdfunding campaign ends.
